verdict.rationale: Airwallex's AgentOS toolkit lets AI agents read balances and 'build cashflow reports,' which implies some data-analysis/insight generation, but this is framed as an external agent-automation toolkit rather than an in-product AI insights/suggestions feature for end users. Missing for 10: evidence of a native in-app AI insights dashboard or proactive suggestion feature surfaced to users, and any concrete example of AgentOS-generated cashflow insights in use.
